run_roundbase_teacher: run the RoundBaseTeacher to load ANLI round data with dialog format and binary class options
run_r1_teacher: run the R1Teacher to train on ANLI round 1 natural language inference data
run_r2_teacher: run the R2Teacher to train on ANLI round 2 natural language inference data
run_r3_teacher: run the R3Teacher to train on ANLI round 3 natural language inference data
run_default_teacher: run the DefaultTeacher to train on all three ANLI rounds as a multi-task teacher
